purpose: Local CPU rerun of the observed (permutation 0) runs from the public files, 27 October 2026; checks that the public pipeline runs end to end. The manuscript values come from the original GPU runs.
features: extract.py on all 3,444 FACED full-trial files; every source SHA-256 matched inputs/disjoint_signed/input_qc.csv
manuscript_informed_observed: no graph 13.8%, distance prior 13.8% (difference -0.1 points), recurrence-similarity graph 13.5%
note: CPU and GPU training are not bit-identical: against the retained GPU pilot prediction file, the CPU class probabilities differ by at most 0.048 with identical trial keys and labels, which near chance (11.1%) moves balanced accuracy by up to about 2 points. Both runs agree that neither graph improves on the no-graph model.
